title: 第2515章 末日系统五52第2514章 末日系统五51
content_zh:
要不是将臣及时出手，诗雅肯定赶不上五十年一次，精灵节啦。要说，孔雀心理还是有点数的，看着马小玲放龙，愣是没敢上来比比划划，没办法，感觉比比划划完，自己容易先躺尸。
结果就是莱利也感觉很头疼，他们虽然年代比较久，但因为莱利太久没喝血，这个实力差的真心有点多。韩紫枫好奇的问将臣：“就算是这俩，也不可能够去盘古秘境的水平吧？”
将臣沉默一下说：“灵魂是另一个境界。”
紫枫撇撇嘴，感觉还是很命运的感觉，没办法，就感觉中间就是差点啥。她本着不理解就问的原则说：“大叔，是不是命运又，又，又搞事了，为啥感觉，又是那种，那里差点什么的感觉？”
将臣指着王珍珍和况天佑说：“别的不说，你就看那俩凡人的战斗力，干的过六代的僵尸，合理吗？”
紫枫都被气笑了，没错，现在王珍珍和况天佑，整拎着不知道哪里弄来的片刀，正追着那些黑眼的僵尸砍呢。紫枫叹口气，吐槽：“嗯嗯，拿个小魔杖，都比现在的情况正常，你家僵尸都能物理驱魔了是吧？”
将臣叹口气说：“我现在就感觉特别丢人。我们家僵尸，啥时候能物理驱魔啦？”
紫枫开心补刀：“那啥，吸血鬼可以物理驱魔的说。”将臣疑惑看向紫枫，紫枫吐槽：“是地域差异，这边的吸血鬼，转化起来比较弱。”
将臣看了看，再次叹口气，还是吐槽：“那也不能叫凡人追着砍吧。”紫枫嘿嘿嘿，嘿嘿嘿嘿。只是眼前这个场景，瞬间就想到物理驱邪第一人，左千户。现在的况天佑，真就拿着片刀，去物理驱魔。
况国华都看的表示很无语，不是，自家孙子疯了吧？居然拎着刀去物理驱邪，更搞笑的是，居然真打的过，这就很耐人寻味啦。
他忍不住上来，疑惑的问：“不是，这个场景合理吗？”
紫枫摇摇头说：“我俩也觉得不太合理，你看看马小玲的表情，都僵住啦，你孙子和王珍珍两个凡人，打的都快比他狠辣。”况天佑一拍脑壳再一拍脑壳，就感觉很割裂的感觉。
况国华上来一句：“这里面有问题吧？”
紫枫点头说：“我们也觉得有问题，等秦始皇开启暴走后，你上，不然你孙子就不保啦。”
况国华点头，他现在还是速度型选手，以现在的速度，和现在的距离，想救孙子还是很容易的。只是，明显计划赶不上变化，虽然孔雀还在旁边喊手下留情，但莱利也不傻，想要硬扛，确实难度有点大，毕竟，他也就是个四代。
好在，将臣也表示，就算灭莱利和诗雅也要等到精灵节后，马小玲就剩下翻白眼了。她吐槽：“所以，我们一行变这么强，又是不甘寂寞的命运？”
一群人都笑了，这话说的有些扎心啦。好不容易等到精灵节，况天佑和珍珍被强行带过来观礼，至于其他小伙伴，也在外面站着，看完整个婚礼流程。
紫枫忍不住吐槽：“分明是人类的贪婪，干嘛说项链不吉利？又是推测责任的一天。”将臣无语，果然，婚礼还是进行的很顺利的。
这边婚礼才结束，诗雅分分钟就再次开启作死计划，她也是真不禁打，加上孔雀也不管，结果就是，一个火神借法，就把诗雅给送走了。结果，莱利再次进入发狂状态，然后，况天佑不知道怎么想的，居然大无畏的往前冲冲冲......
看着再次被干的奄奄一息的况天佑，紫枫无奈望望天，感觉命运又，又，又开始犯贱啦。紫枫质疑：“救不救？”

将臣一摊手：“关我什么事儿？”
况国华则看向紫枫，紫枫还是给他兑换了一颗复原丹，没办法感觉这个哥们主打一个死于意外是吧？别说，末日系统发的丹药，还是蛮靠谱的，一颗丹药下去，况天佑也算是满血复活。
另一边，发狂的莱利明显马小玲对付就有很大难度了，不为别的，在紫枫看来，那是纯纯的武功碾压，更逗的是，马小玲放龙，莱利也放龙，一下就给大家都整不会了。
只是在将臣和紫枫眼中，马小玲的龙是真龙魂，但莱利的龙，更像是气运神龙。所以，两龙一击之下，马小玲的龙居然输了。
马小玲也疑惑了，不是，这个三代这么夸张的吗？紫枫剧透：“请叫他嬴政。”
马小玲顿时一拍脑袋，那莱利的龙能干掉她的龙，就一点不用意外了，只是，越想越气的马小玲居然来一句：“你们作弊吧。”
无语的众僵尸，多少是真有点无语了，这次出手的是碧加，结果，很好，身为才进化的一代僵尸，居然没打过这个三代就算了，莱利居然借助碧加的力量，居然在大家眼不前就进化成二代。
紫枫歪头问：“不是，不是，合理吗？”
将臣回答：“倒是在合理范畴哈。”
紫枫吐槽：“那里合理了，屁大个功夫，这货都从四代进化到二代了，你告诉我合理？”
将臣：“确实在合理范畴，他本身就是三代，之前只是饿太久啦，愤怒叫他返回三代实力很正常。碧加这个一代虽然有点水是没错，但好歹也算是摸到一代的门槛，再加上都是我的后裔的后裔，叫他返个二代，也算正常，毕竟他好歹是嬴政。”
紫枫摸摸鼻子，只能说，这个说法吧，合理中透着不合理，不合理中还透着一丝丝合理。她结案陈词的说：“嗯，感觉命运那个家伙，又欠收拾了，瞧这个仗叫他玩的，能不能行啦。”
将臣再补一句：“其实，就算他变一代，也是合理的，这样他们就能跟着去盘古秘境啦。”
紫枫吐槽：“所以你准备叫马小玲杀个寂寞，信不信他跟你比比划划？”
将臣无语的说：“打不赢我。”
紫枫想想说：“真不一定，你看现在莱利和诗雅都快变一代了，你猜，等你被五条龙祸害的时候，命运敢不敢把五条龙给你变的更加难对付一些？”
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo
content_en:
If it weren't for the timely action of the generals, Shiya would definitely not be able to catch up with the Elf Festival, which happens once every fifty years. I have to say that I still have some peacock psychology. When I saw Ma Xiaoling letting go, I didn't dare to come up and gesture. I had no choice but to feel that after the gesture, I would easily lie down first.
As a result, Riley also felt a headache. Although they were older, but because Riley hadn't drank blood for too long, the difference in strength was really quite large. Han Zifeng asked the general curiously: "Even these two can't possibly reach the level of Pangu Secret Realm, right?"
The general was silent for a moment and said, "The soul is in another realm."
Zifeng curled her lips, feeling very fateful. She had no choice but to feel that something was almost missing. She followed the principle of asking if she didn't understand: "Uncle, has fate caused trouble again? Why do you feel like something is almost there again?"
The general pointed at Wang Zhenzhen and Kuang Tianyou and said, "If you don't say anything else, just look at the fighting power of those two mortals. Is it reasonable to think that they can fight six generations of zombies?"
Zifeng laughed in anger, yes, now Wang Zhenzhen and Kuang Tianyou were chasing those black-eyed zombies with knives they got from nowhere. Zifeng sighed and complained: "Hmm, with a small wand, it's more normal than the current situation. Your zombies can physically exorcise demons, right?"
The general sighed and said, "I feel very embarrassed right now. When will our zombies be able to physically exorcise demons?"
Zifeng happily lasted: "What, vampires can physically exorcise demons." The general looked at Zifeng in confusion, and Zifeng complained: "It's a regional difference. The vampires here are relatively weak in transformation."
The general looked at it, sighed again, and complained: "Then we can't let mortals chase and chop." Zifeng hehehe, hehehehe. Just the scene in front of me immediately reminded me of Zuo Qianhu, the first person to physically exorcise evil spirits. Now Kuang Tianyou really just takes a knife to exorcise demons physically.
Kuang Guohua was speechless when he saw it. No, his grandson is crazy, right? He actually carried a knife to physically exorcise evil spirits. What's even more funny is that he actually managed to fight them. This is very intriguing.
He couldn't help but come up and asked doubtfully: "No, is this scene reasonable?"
Zifeng shook his head and said, "We don't think it's unreasonable. Look at Ma Xiaoling's expression. She's frozen. Your grandson and Wang Zhenzhen, two mortals, beat him faster and harder." Kuang Tianyou slapped his head again and again, feeling very separated.
Kuang Guohua came up and said, "Is there something wrong here?"
Zifeng nodded and said: "We also think there is a problem. When Qin Shihuang starts going on a rampage, you come in, otherwise your grandson will not be protected."
Kuang Guohua nodded. He was still a speed player. With his current speed and current distance, it would be easy to save his grandson. However, it was obvious that the plan could not keep up with the changes. Although Peacock was still shouting for mercy, Riley was not stupid. It was indeed a bit difficult to handle it forcefully. After all, he was only a fourth generation.
Fortunately, the general also said that even if Riley and Shiya were killed, they would have to wait until after the Elf Festival, leaving Ma Xiaoling to just roll her eyes. She complained: "So, our group has become so strong, but we are unwilling to be lonely?"
A group of people laughed, these words were a bit heartbreaking. After finally waiting for the Fairy Day, Kuang Tianyou and Zhenzhen were forcibly brought over to watch the ceremony. As for the other friends, they also stood outside and watched the entire wedding process.
Zifeng couldn't help complaining: "It's clearly human greed, why do you say the necklace is unlucky? Another day of speculation about responsibility." The general was speechless. Sure enough, the wedding went smoothly.
The wedding here had just ended, and Shiya started her suicide plan again within minutes. She couldn't help but fight, and Peacock didn't care. The result was that a Vulcan took advantage of her and sent Shiya away. As a result, Riley went into a state of madness again, and then, Kuang Tianyou didn't know what he thought, but he actuallyCharge forward fearlessly...
Seeing Kuang Tianyou being fucked on the verge of death again, Zifeng looked helplessly at the sky, feeling that fate had begun to be mean again. Zifeng questioned: "Save or not?"
The general spread his hands: "What does it have to do with me?"
Kuang Guohua looked at Zifeng, who still exchanged a recovery pill for him. He couldn't believe that this buddy died in an accident, right? Not to mention, the pills issued by the doomsday system are quite reliable. If you take one pill, Kuang Tianyou can be regarded as resurrected with full health.
On the other side, the crazy Riley was obviously very difficult for Ma Xiaoling to deal with. If nothing else, in Zifeng's opinion, it was a pure martial arts crushing. What's even more funny is that when Ma Xiaoling let go of the dragon, Riley also let go of the dragon, and everyone couldn't deal with it at once.
But in the eyes of Jiang Chen and Zifeng, Ma Xiaoling's dragon is a real dragon soul, but Riley's dragon is more like a dragon of luck. Therefore, after the two dragons struck each other, Ma Xiaoling's dragon actually lost.
Ma Xiaoling was also confused, isn't it, is this third generation so exaggerated? Zifeng spoilers: "Please call him Ying Zheng."
Ma Xiaoling immediately slapped her head. It was no surprise that Riley's dragon could kill her dragon. However, the more she thought about it, the more angry Ma Xiaoling became. She actually said, "You guys should cheat."
The speechless zombies were more or less speechless. This time it was Biga who took action. The result was very good. As a first-generation zombie that had just evolved, it didn't matter that he hadn't beaten the third generation. Riley actually used Biga's power to evolve into the second generation without everyone's eyes.
Zifeng tilted his head and asked: "No, no, is it reasonable?"
The general replied: "It is within the reasonable range."
Zifeng complained: "That's reasonable. It's a big deal. This guy has evolved from the fourth generation to the second generation. You tell me it's reasonable?"
General: "It is indeed within the reasonable scope. He himself is a third generation. He was just hungry for too long before. It is normal for him to be angry and ask him to return to the third generation. Although Bijia's generation is a bit weak, it is right that he has touched the threshold of the first generation. In addition, they are all descendants of my descendants. It is normal to ask him to return to the second generation. After all, he is Ying Zheng."
Zifeng touched her nose and could only say that this statement is reasonable but also unreasonable, and unreasonable but also slightly reasonable. She concluded her case by saying, "Well, I feel like that guy named Destiny needs to be dealt with again. Let's see if he can handle this battle he was asked to play."
The general added: "In fact, it is reasonable even if he changes to another generation, so that they can follow him to Pangu's secret realm."
Zifeng complained: "So you are going to ask Ma Xiaoling to kill Lonely. Do you believe that he will show off with you?"
The general said speechlessly: "You can't defeat me."
Zifeng thought about it and said, "It's not necessarily true. You see, Riley and Shiya are about to change a generation now. Guess, when you are harmed by the five dragons, will fate dare to make the five dragons more difficult for you to deal with?"
